notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only sources are the tnlandforms list entry (name, county, elevation; the page is dated as revised 2016) and a 2013 FFLA report that says one Richmond County tower was to go to auction for removal without naming it. Two WebSearch queries found no Georgia Reid lookout history. A Mississippi lookout is also called Reid (nhlr reid-lookout-tower); it is a different structure. The Augusta Broad Street bell tower that search turned up is not a forestry lookout and is left out. Worth checking Georgia Forestry Commission property records for whether the Richmond County tower sold, and whether it was this one. Story is below the 120-word floor because no source supports more.
